instruction: Look at gui_017_adapter_block.step in SolidWorks, a 70 x 50 x 18 mm adapter block with a 20 mm through center hole. Enlarge the center hole to diameter 25 mm. Add four counterbored holes at (25,15), (25,-15), (-25,15), and (-25,-15). Each counterbored hole has 6 mm through diameter, 12 mm counterbore diameter, and 5 mm counterbore depth from the top face. Add a 2 mm chamfer to the top outer perimeter. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_017_adapter_counterbore_out.step. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
